Message.Name: Logon Message
Message.Description: Allows the client to login to the server.

Field.Name: CompID
Field.Description: Interface User ID (CompID) assigned to the client

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password assigned to the Interface User ID (CompID)

Field.Name: New Password
Field.Description: New password for Interface User ID (CompID)

Field.Name: Protocol Version
Field.Description: Specifies the version of protocol

Message.Name: Logon Response Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to accept or reject a login request.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Will be zero or three if login is accepted

Field.Name: Password Expiry
Field.Description: Number of days for password expiry

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: Used by the client or server to terminate a session.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reason for the logout

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Used by the client and server to exercise the communication line during periods of inactivity.

Message.Name: Reject Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to reject a message that does not comply with the specifications.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject

Field.Name: Reject Reason
Field.Description: Reason for the reject

Field.Name: Message Type
Field.Description: Type of message rejected

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the rejected message if it is available

Message.Name: Missed Message Request Message
Message.Description: Used by the client to recover missed messages through the Recovery Channel.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Identity of the matching partition the request relates to

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number immediately after that of the last message received from the partition

Message.Name: Missed Message Request Ack Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to accept or reject a request for missed messages.

Field.Name: Missed Message Status
Field.Description: Outcome of the missed message request

Message.Name: Transmission Complete Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to indicate that the transmission of missed messages is complete.

Field.Name: Transmission Status
Field.Description: Outcome of the missed message transmission

Message.Name: System Status Message
Message.Description: Disseminated in the recovery channel to indicate the status of a partition.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Identity of the matching partition the message relates to

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Status of the partition

Field.Name: Trader Mnemonic

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Client Account information

Field.Name: Order Type
Field.Description: Type of the order

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: How long the order remains in effect

Field.Name: Expire Time
Field.Description: Date and time the order expires on

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order

Field.Name: Order Quantity
Field.Description: Total order quantity

Field.Name: Display Quantity
Field.Description: Maximum quantity that may be displayed

Field.Name: Minimum Quantity

Field.Name: Limit Price

Field.Name: Stop Price

Field.Name: Capacity

Field.Name: Order Book

Field.Description: Whether the order is a pegged order

Field.Name: Self Trade Prevention Key
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of order relevant to self-match
